'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Jessica Echeverria DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jessica Echeverria]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
